items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Reig was connected with Savoy label at that time.

ctx.x: Okay, Cozy, we took a break for a while and we got to talking a little bit about all the recordings you did for Savoy in the '40s. Do you want to talk a little about that?
Yes. Teddy Reig was connected with Savoy label at that time. I did a lot of things for Savoy with a combination trumpet, tenor, and three rhythm, and Lubinsky...
